sources.title: FishAI: Automated hierarchical marine fish image classification with ...
sources.snippet: Trained with marine fish images collected from the World Register of Marine Species, FishAI used the Vision Transformer (ViT) model, to classify fish. The model considers hierarchy levels, covering 3 classes, 38 orders, 154 families, 438 genera, and 808 species.
